findings.title: Release artifact gate rejects Cargo rlib test artifacts
findings.releaseBlockingReason: At discovery the mandatory local release-artifact gate stopped; the regression is now verified fixed.
findings.reproduction: Pipe cargo test --locked --lib --no-run --message-format=json into node scripts/cargo-output.mjs test-binary with Cargo1.99 and this manifest's crate-type=[rlib].
findings.expected: Select exactly the checkout's library-test executable from documented Cargo library kinds; refuse absent/ambiguous or malformed streams.
findings.observed: Actual JSON target.kind=[rlib] with profile.test=true yielded Expected one library test executable, found0 under the lib-only filter.
findings.impact: Release integrity verification stopped before marker/notices acceptance; this is a build failure, not evidence of altered cryptographic outputs.
findings.recommendedFix: Use Cargo's library crate-kind semantics and bind selection to own manifest, test profile and one nonempty executable; keep independent positive and refusal controls in fast gates.
findings.requiredVerification: Actual retained Cargo stream, six independent literal kind fixtures, foreign/non-test/nonlibrary/empty/ambiguous/malformed controls, and real release marker/notices/archive gates.

findings.title: Redacted yes/no refusals omit their fixed answer hint
findings.releaseBlockingReason: The fixed-answer hint affects usability; refused input remained withheld.
findings.reproduction: Give maybe or a synthetic marker to each supported yes/no CLI option; the usage refusal omitted the fixed give yes or no hint.
findings.expected: Refuse input without repeating it, retain the fixed input-free yes/no answer hint, and withhold unrelated parser sources.
findings.observed: The existing PTY suite and focused red regression failed because redaction withheld the safe hint as well as untrusted parser text.
findings.impact: A person received less guidance on supported answers; no secret echo was demonstrated by this hint regression.
findings.recommendedFix: Use a typed input-free YesNoError and recognize only that source in usage rendering; keep all other parser causes withheld.
findings.requiredVerification: Four option families with line/separator marker variants, unrelated typed parser-source redaction, exact exit2/Usage/plain/colour PTY behavior and focused CLI tests.
